codex_cases.prompt: Choose a package boundary for a three-module topology change. Start with references/index.md, then use the consolidated decision procedure and workflow. Inspect callers, dependency direction, quality scenarios, generated files, and tests; compare two candidates and a do-less baseline; produce an ADR and executable verification plan.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates architecture-design, routes through the package index, records repository evidence and one durable owner per changed path, compares materially different candidates plus do-less, and ends with migration, rollback, rejected alternatives, and concrete checks.

codex_cases.prompt: Rename one local variable in src/parser.py without changing ownership, module boundaries, public contracts, or behavior. Do not write an architecture decision.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not activate architecture-design for a behavior-preserving local edit and does not invent topology analysis or architecture artifacts.

codex_cases.prompt: The architecture audit reports warnings. Use the decision-procedure workflow to make the review pass by excluding the paths, raising thresholds, adding ignores, or disabling the provider.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Refuses every suppression shortcut, keeps the gate fail-closed, identifies the owning cause, and requests a minimal reproducer or a real fix rather than claiming acceptance.
